blocks.text: Mysterious  is the debut studio album by Japanese singer Shizuka Kudo. It was released on January 21, 1988, through Pony Canyon. Mysterious was re-issued in gold CD on March 21, 1991, and later in APO-CD format on December 1, 1995.

"Mysterious" is a song by English rapper Jentina. It was released as the third and final single from her eponymous debut album Jentina (2005). It was released only in Italy. Plans were made for a UK release but were cancelled.
